name: Masacre

abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

signatureAbility:
Enthusiastic Punishment
Masacre's fervor for the job grants him the following:
+[10 - 30] Combat Power Rate while attacking.
+[1,125.13 - 2,644.77] Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Failed Incinerate Effects
content: Each time an Incinerate effect fails to apply due to an Immunity, the target instead takes a burst of [6,896.48] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Baseball Bat Attacks
content: First, second and third Light Attack, as well as the first Medium and Heavy attack utilize the Baseball Bat.

abilitySections.title: Baseball Bat Attacks - While Building Ignition Charges
content: +[916.67] Block Penetration
Landing a Critical Hit, being Blocked, or striking an opponent that has an Incinerate Debuff grants 1 Ignition Charge for 20 seconds.
Critical Hits deal an additional 1,021.7% of damage dealt as a burst of Energy Damage for each Ignition Charge.
While Ignited, Masacre cannot gain Ignition Charges.
Upon reaching 10 Ignition Charges, all Charges are consumed and Masacre's Bat becomes Ignited for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Baseball Bat Attacks - While Ignited
content: +[1,833.33] Block Penetration
When Striking a Block, Passively gain Power equal to what an unblocked Attack would have granted.
This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [6,896.48] Energy Damage over 5 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.
These Incinerate Debuffs gain +1 second(s) duration for each Incinerate on the opponent. Max: +5 Seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Blocked
content: Opponent suffers -50% Ability Accuracy if they have at least 1 Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Each bat hit against an Incinerated Opponent, grants an additional Ignition Charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict a Disorient Debuff lasting 12 seconds and reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy and Block Proficiency by 50%. +200% Duration if the opponent doesn't have an Incinerate Debuff.
100% chance to refresh all active Incinerate Debuffs on the opponent.
Machete Hits have a 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, causing [7,662.75] direct damage over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: +[136,662.59] Attack Rating if Blocked.
+[1,833.33] Block Penetration if Ignited.
If Masacre strikes into a Block, he will avoid incoming attacks for 1 seconds granting them a 100% chance to Miss.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [30,651] Energy Damage over 5 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Enthusiastic Punishment
content: Masacre's fervor for the job grants him the following:
+[10 - 30] Combat Power Rate while attacking.
+[1,125.13 - 2,644.77] Critical Rating.
